PROJECT 8 – TWO-STOREY ADMIN BUILDING EXTENSION (BAGUIO TEACHERS CAMP)

Problem: DepEd commissions an RLA to design and manage an admin extension at the Baguio Teachers Camp for the Purchasing and Engineering Departments. The offices go on the 2nd floor.

Requirements:
• Ground floor, right corner, 30 m total width: business center (168 m², 12 m wide), lobby and stair (60 m², 6 m wide), Storage 1 (120 m², the remaining width). Open decks: 6 × 14 m on the business center's right side, 18 × 10 m in front, and 6 × 10 m at the lobby, all with steps.
• Storage 2 (300 m², 15 m wide) attached to Storage 1, for construction materials under the Purchasing Department.
• Workshop for Engineering, 40 m wide, 800 m², aligned with Storage 2, with a 60 m² locker room/T&B/shower and fire-rated partitions.
• A 4 × 73 m docking/delivery platform behind the workshop, storages and lobby, with a ramp and stairs.
• Rear driveway, loading, parking and multipurpose open space, 24 × 105 m; a 3.0 m × 72 m² softscape strip after the workshop; a 6.0 m driveway to the main road; front and side setbacks as gardens.
• Second floor: stairwell over the lobby; Engineering office the same size as and over the business center; Purchasing office the same size as and over Storage 1; a 4 × 18 m balcony.

Objectives: Match the existing admin building; use local Baguio stone; wide windows, since there will be no air-conditioning.

Site: At the left corner of the main road (south) and a secondary road (east); rear and left are open camp land. Group C (Education and Recreation), Division C, zoned GI (General Institutional). Slopes down 3% from the main street. Front and right setbacks are 5.0 m; utilities are available.

PROJECT 9 – EXPANSION OF THE ADMIN BUILDING EXTENSION (BAGUIO TEACHERS CAMP)

Problem: The 2010 admin extension building at the Baguio Teachers Camp will be renovated by the camp's in-house RLA under owner's administration. It houses the Purchasing and Engineering Departments on the 2nd floor, with the business center, Storage 1, Storage 2 and workshop on the ground floor.

As-built data:
• Ground floor, right corner, 30 m total width: business center 276 m² (12 m), lobby with stair 84 m² (6 m), Storage 1 168 m². Decks: 6 × 23 m on the right side, 18 × 7 m in front, plus front decks at the lobby and Storage 1.
• Storage 2: 375 m², 15 m wide. Workshop: 40 m wide, 1,000 m², with a 60 m² locker room/T&B and fire-rated partitions; to its left, a 9 m strip (1.5 m softscape, 7.5 m driveway).
• A docking platform 5 m × 73 m at the back; a rear service area 24 × 105 m.
• Second floor: Engineering office over the business center, Purchasing office over Storage 1, a 9 × 18 m balcony.
• Slabs: GF decks 150 mm, GF slabs 100 mm, loading area 170 mm; 2nd-floor slabs 100 mm on steel deck. GF line +300 mm and decks +150 mm above the sidewalk.

Objectives: Add a 1,375 m² multipurpose hall on the 2nd floor over the workshop and Storage 2, keeping the rest of the building in use; verify actual conditions and code compliance; review costs for the renovation estimate.

Site: Corner of the main road (south) and a secondary road (east), sloping down 3% toward the rear. Group C, Division C, zoned GI. Front and right setbacks 5.0 m.
